source_claim_or_motif: Normalized SDF in [0,1]
formalization_decision: Normalization is a code/drive map. The signed field and its sign convention remain separate; a value in [0,1] is not by itself a signed distance.

source_claim_or_motif: Klein-cone polynomial is an acoustic signed distance
formalization_decision: The supplied polynomial specifies an implicit zero set. No distance identity, topology proof or calibrated acoustic law is supplied. It is not the runtime pressure law.

source_claim_or_motif: phi supplies the unique growth scale
formalization_decision: The reciprocal golden-ratio motif remains source notation. Frozen 3.1 assets actually use turtle_shrink=0.72, not phi. Changing this requires a new asset seed.

source_claim_or_motif: Trichromatic channels are frequency and interference physics
formalization_decision: The retained uint32 texel holds a biased signed field code and an unsigned drive. Neither component denotes a physical frequency or actuator setting.

source_claim_or_motif: Unbalanced BST finds an 8-bit pointer in three steps
formalization_decision: A generic unbalanced tree has no such fixed depth guarantee. The shipped execution uses direct, bounded dense LUT indexing, not this unspecified BST.

source_claim_or_motif: Shifting the top bit is pulse-density conversion
formalization_decision: Bit selection and lossless serialization differ from pulse-density quantization. The retained residual accumulator defines the emitted pulse sequence.

source_claim_or_motif: XOR random jitter eliminates quantization noise
formalization_decision: No runtime noise is injected. Arbitrary XOR can change pulse counts and break the stated codec identity. No blue-noise or spectral-quality claim is made.

source_claim_or_motif: Parity guarantees telemetry integrity
formalization_decision: XOR parity detects odd-weight bit changes in a checked word, not every error and not malicious replacement. Hash checking is separate.

source_claim_or_motif: Parity is symmetric-difference blending
formalization_decision: The indicator identity 1_(A triangle B)=1_A XOR 1_B is exact. It does not identify metric distance blending with a scalar parity reduction.

source_claim_or_motif: Parity gives topological volume or dimension
formalization_decision: Parity gives cardinality modulo two for the represented bits. Topological dimension or physical volume is not obtained from this reduction.

source_claim_or_motif: Geometry plus parity supplies zero-overhead encryption
formalization_decision: No encryption scheme or adversarial security proof is supplied. Capsule SHA-256 detects changes against a trusted digest; it is not a signature.

source_claim_or_motif: Passive photonics has zero operational latency
formalization_decision: There is no photonic layout, fabrication model, propagation budget or device measurement in the package. No zero-latency statement is certified.

source_claim_or_motif: Log-radius automatically implements time dilation
formalization_decision: The runtime phase is a finite logical index. No Lorentz transformation, relativistic channel or physical time-dilation model is implemented.

source_claim_or_motif: IPD and ITD are one interchangeable spatial quantity
formalization_decision: The source explicitly clarifies IPD as interpupillary distance. IPD and ITD retain different types and units; they are not inputs to this autonomous numerical release.

source_claim_or_motif: T is both geometry and an exact arrival root
formalization_decision: T as a geometric motif, continuous root time and integer update index are typed separately. Earlier analytic toy roots are not the kernel clock or a calibrated arrival law.

source_claim_or_motif: Every field has one homogeneous SDF type
formalization_decision: U4 uses a product state with an exact binary encoding. Lemma C13 constructs a true SDF representation of each encoded state; no implicit type equivalence is assumed.

source_claim_or_motif: One sign evaluation solves every boundary-crossing time
formalization_decision: A sign query alone does not specify a root-search algorithm, uniqueness or a time bracket. This release uses declared discrete thresholds and update rules.

source_claim_or_motif: Geometry completely eliminates execution
formalization_decision: The deliverable is executable software requiring an interpreter/compiler, memory and hardware execution. Representational equivalence is not zero work.

source_claim_or_motif: Human consciousness is this field loop
formalization_decision: Causal self-feedback is proved for the model. The corpus supplies no experiment identifying the resulting computation with human subjective experience.

source_claim_or_motif: Hadamard transform is the same operator as XOR
formalization_decision: Walsh characters may be indexed by binary parity, while the real-valued transform sums weighted amplitudes. H squared equals 2I for the displayed 2x2 matrix; it is not a Boolean XOR gate.

source_claim_or_motif: Memory is permanent quantum-holographic geometry
formalization_decision: The executable memory is a bounded integer moving average that affects subsequent field sampling. Permanent biological storage and electron-cloud mechanisms are not established.

source_claim_or_motif: alpha/beta/gamma grammar completes all growth
formalization_decision: The sketch does not specify the complete interpreter and all operational rules. The total XX/XY grammar from earlier releases remains authoritative for these assets.

source_claim_or_motif: A single scalar seed contains an arbitrary infinite structure
formalization_decision: The complete seed contains program semantics, grammar/interpreter parameters and frozen LUT bytes. One selector bit chooses between predeclared alternatives; it does not replace their descriptions.

source_claim_or_motif: phi guarantees perfect self-similarity at every scale
formalization_decision: The implementation contains five finite baked levels with explicit sampling. It proves neither infinite self-similarity nor a universal scale law.

source_claim_or_motif: Kinematic advection automatically preserves an SDF
formalization_decision: A transported scalar field and a unit-gradient distance function are different conditions. The implemented transport is an integer graph law, not an asserted continuum PDE equivalence.

source_claim_or_motif: An infinite log-polar LUT gives infinite near-field precision
formalization_decision: The frozen chart excludes r=0 and has finite radial/angular bins. No interpolation or infinite-resolution claim is used by the closure theorem.

source_claim_or_motif: The pseudocode is a completed executable operator chain
disposition: SOURCE SKETCH COMPLETED IN NEW CODE
formalization_decision: The source calls undefined functions and includes float operations. New C++ and Python files define the actual finite transition, serialization, checks and Boolean arithmetic.

source_claim_or_motif: f:R^n to R has matching range and domain
formalization_decision: For n not equal to one this is not an endomorphism. U4 instead specifies T_sigma:S_sigma to S_sigma and a conjugate map on the image of its binary/SDF encoding.

source_claim_or_motif: A Klein-bottle hinge enforces physical closure
formalization_decision: Geometric or topological closure does not alone establish causal or thermodynamic isolation. The actual index graph has angular wrap and radial no-exterior-edge boundaries.

source_claim_or_motif: The final parity token is the entire next seed
formalization_decision: The previous output participates in feedback, but residuals, material, memory, latches, phase, level and cooldown remain. The exact quotient criterion rejects unsupported one-bit erasure.

source_claim_or_motif: The engine requires no external buffers or runtime
formalization_decision: The operational law is autonomous after initialization; the program still uses old/new buffers, software and hardware. The capsule stores sufficient state, not the whole physical computer.

source_claim_or_motif: All past and future states are already materially present
formalization_decision: A deterministic rule fixes a mathematical trajectory. It does not store the complete trace or eliminate future execution. Only sufficient present state is checkpointed.

source_claim_or_motif: Absolute closure implies a digital perpetuum mobile
formalization_decision: U4 proves finite-state operational closure and eventual recurrence, not free energy or unlimited physical operation.

source_claim_or_motif: Absolute step and last-growth are necessary state
formalization_decision: The operative phase is (n*stride) mod width; cooldown is min(dwell,n-last_growth). These are sufficient for the retained autonomous transition.

source_claim_or_motif: Cumulative K and Q must remain operational forever
formalization_decision: K and Q do not drive any next-cell equation. They are external segment witnesses; the residual remains operational. The exact certificate is generalized to nonzero segment-start residuals.

source_claim_or_motif: CUDA source equivalence proves the laptop already passed
formalization_decision: This release includes a CUDA verification target, but no nvcc or NVIDIA device was available here. CPU, Boolean and solver results never substitute for local GPU evidence.
